# Functional face fixture

`astronaut.png`: NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins, public domain, distributed by scikit-image.

Retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png . Reference: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut .

Used only to verify real face detection, cheek extraction and UI flow. It is not a labelled seasonal-colour dataset, and tests using it do not establish recommendation accuracy.
